'''Dimmock''' was the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Duke/Legends|duke]] of [[Trellik Hive]] and the chief rival of Duke [[Piddock]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At one point, Dimmock discovered that his rival was involved in a deal with [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />
